summary.en: One big number counts up to the size of a set while one square per item appears in a wave beside it; the squares stay for every later chapter.
summary.zh: 一个大数字数到集合的总数，旁边一格一件事按数据顺序波浪式出现；这些方块留给后面每一章。

fits: The opening of a story told by counting: how many there are, before saying which kinds.
notFor: A single headline number with nothing to sort afterwards (use a number scene of a launch style); more than about 2,000 items.

intent.en: The viewer feels the size of the set before any category: a number counts while one square per item fills the frame.
intent.zh: 观众先感到集合有多大，再谈分类：数字往上数，同时一件一格铺满画面。

content.en: The set as groups (1–9, name ≤ 14 chars / 6 字, count); a caption (≤ 34 chars / 14 字) and a note on what one square is (≤ 40 / 16 字).
content.zh: 按组给出集合（1–9 组，名称 ≤ 14 字符 / 6 字，带数量）；一行说明（≤ 34 字符 / 14 字）和一行注明一格是什么（≤ 40 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 用计数讲的故事的开场：先讲有多少，再讲哪几类。

notFor.zh: 只有一个大数字、之后没有可分类的东西（用发布片风格的数字场景）；超过约 2000 件。

pairs.note: the first re-sort of the same squares
carries the grid into the next chapter

en: Set `title: ''` unless the count needs a claim; the caption is the main read.
The squares must stay on screen into the next chapter; cutting them away loses the through-line.
zh: 除非计数本身就是主张，否则 `title` 留空；主读是说明。
方块要留到下一章；切掉就丢了贯穿线索。

overlaps.note: its crowd is a scatter of dots each standing for several units; here one square is one item, in data order

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
